_doc: The free-roam valley (brief 2.10). Owner: roam. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_valley. TankRoamMap builds the map from a seed (ctx.rng on the host, carried in the snapshot): length_m drawn in [lo, hi] (game metres); first_zone and last_zone at the two ends, the middle zones once each in a seeded order, with forest between two of them at forest_between odds; zone lengths drawn from len_m and scaled to fill the road. Terrain: points terrain_step_m apart, each drawn from its zone's terrain_pct, moving at most terrain_max_step_pct from the last, flat over end_flat_m at both ends; grades are for travel east and negated westward, always clamped to terrain_pct (-3..+5%, inside BRIEF 4.6.6's -3..+6%). start_m: where the hull's centre starts (the west end, facing east); end_m: the turning places, where the road stops for the hull's centre. drive_out_s: the WARMUP drive-out (>= 300 s, BRIEF 4.6.8); overtime_s: how long a fight in progress may run past time up (max_s = min_s + overtime_s). Strongpoints: one dug-in tank per listed zone at a seeded spot (at least min_gap_m apart, clear_ends_m from either end), back respawn_s after it falls; one stands on the field only while its spot is near the screen, never in the drive-out or after time up; the tank halts to engage one ahead within engage_px (rules px from the hull's front to its near edge) and any heavy tank within engage_heavy_px. Patrols: one every every_s seconds of WORK time (drawn), ahead of the tank at ahead_share odds else behind (always behind with less than clear_ahead_m of road ahead), a kind drawn by weight (heavy only past heavy_after_s of WORK time and with no heavy alive), counts drawn from each unit's [lo, hi] and scaled like mission counts (tanks.json enemy_scale), trimmed to max_alive enemies on the field (none fit: retry_s later); none after time up. fight_px: an enemy this near (rules px from the hull's nearer end) is a fight in progress at time up. Turn: an 8 s stop with the flip at its midpoint, a 30 s cooldown, the Autopilot turning autopilot_wait_s after reaching an end, and the crew turning on its own after forced_wait_s when a hand-playing driver does not. Points per kill by enemy type, per evaded shot, per breakdown and per full kilometre driven in the roam phase. Grades: points per minute of WORK time; the brief's starting cut-offs (S >= 9, A >= 7, B >= 5, C >= 3) x 2.5, keeping their ratios (P5 tuning, docs/decisions/tank.md: every patrol of a compliant crew dies, about 16-25 points a WORK minute for crews 1-4 on roam_30, so the brief's cut-offs gave every compliant crew S; with these a compliant crew of 3 earns A (17.8-20.1 over seeds 1-3), crews 1, 2 and 4 B to A (one S at 24.8), 85% compliance A or B, 70% B to D). v3 (2026-10-28, docs/decisions/tank.md v3 rules ADR): the valley runs through the forest: the zone ids stay (the wire and the map), each zone is a forest variant or a base clearing (backdrop, TankIds.BACKDROPS; label: the HUD strip's name): forest the pines, lake a fir hollow, village a forest camp and quarry a lumber yard (bases), meadow a birch glade; every strongpoint stands at a little base (strongpoints.backdrop); patrol counts scale with the crew size (enemies.json crew_count_scale).
